title: About
lead: I'm a full-stack developer who likes the backend best: the data model, the queues, and the rules that keep a business's numbers right.
story: I studied computer science at the University of Kerala, at UIT Pirappancode. After graduating in 2024 I spent ten months as a MERN stack intern at Avodha Technologies, building React, Node.js and MongoDB apps.

In June 2025 I joined Oxium Technologies. I started on seller and buyer apps for ONDC, India's open network for digital commerce, and now I build a distribution ERP for a food wholesaler, from the database up to the screens.

Outside work I build things to understand how they really work: an email platform to learn mail delivery, an API tool to think properly about contracts, and a booking app that keeps growing new parts.
howIWork: I write the design down before the code, and keep checking it against the code as both change.
I test against real systems where I can. Recorded requests against a staging server catch things that mocks never will.
I care about the unglamorous parts: retries that are safe to repeat, permissions that match how people really work, and error messages someone can act on.
I use AI coding assistants to move faster on UI work and boilerplate. The architecture, data models and backend logic are my own, and I review every line before it ships.
lookingFor: A backend-leaning full-stack role, remote or in Kerala, on a team that ships to real users and talks openly about trade-offs. I'm most at home in Node.js and TypeScript, and I want to go deeper into distributed systems.

resume.body: A one-page summary of all this, in English.
